entries.zh: 遮日；遮蔽太阳（日遮）
entries.en: to shade from the sun; cover against the sun

entries.zh: 障蔽；遮挡，遮隔（障）
entries.en: to block/screen off; cover, conceal

entries.zh: 覆盖灯火；把火掩住、掩熄（字存疑：撏/撑）
entries.en: to cover/bank the fire; smother the flame
entries.notes: 汉字存疑（撏/撑），据西语「掩盖灯火」与音写 Iāy/tāy 推定掩火之义

entries.zh: 如天穹般笼盖；普覆（字存疑：汙/汗）
entries.en: to cover/spread over as the sky covers
entries.notes: 字存疑（汙/汗），音写 ō 与西义不合，依「如天所覆」取笼盖之义

entries.zh: 覆体掩躯；以贴身衣物掩躯（軀）
entries.en: to cover the body/torso (with a close-fitting garment)
entries.notes: 西语词头含混（corpellos Capallina 不可确解），据汉字「軀」取掩躯覆体之义

entries.zh: 如帐幕般覆罩；围遮如篱（原录作「圖」，疑为「幬」）
entries.en: to cover like a canopy/pavilion; enclose as with a fence
entries.notes: 汉字「圖」与西义不合，或为「幬」（帐覆）之讹，据西语「如帐幕覆罩」取覆罩义

entries.zh: 以被毯覆盖；甲被掩身（甲〔覆〕、被）
entries.en: to cover as with a blanket/cloak

entries.zh: 如披风般掩覆；披挂遮盖（鉸，字疑）
entries.en: to cover/conceal as with a cape
entries.notes: 汉字「鉸」与音写（âe/cān）均不合西义，据「如披风遮盖」推定

entries.zh: 遮盖；掩盖，遮掩（遮盖）
entries.en: to cover, conceal

entries.zh: 如屋顶般覆掩严密（感伊密）
entries.en: to cover close and tight as roofs (tiles) cover
entries.notes: 汉字「感伊密」难与音写、西义确合，依「如屋顶覆盖」取覆掩严密之义

entries.zh: 牵被掩体；拉绣被覆身（牵绣被）
entries.en: to cover oneself by pulling the quilt/bedspread over
entries.notes: 词头 concha 疑为 colcha（被单）之讹，汉字音写「牵绣被」合牵被掩身之义

entries.zh: 以幔帐披覆；或罩掩其上（幔幔）
entries.en: to cover with a canopy/mantle-cloth; to cap or veil over
entries.notes: M 栏并附「罩手帕」音写，与第15条互见

entries.zh: 以披衣掩覆；幔披遮身（幔幔）
entries.en: to cover with a cape/cloak (mantle-cloth)

entries.zh: 以粗外套（payo）掩覆（字存疑：捀/捧）
entries.en: to cover with the payo (rustic's loose cloak/hood)
entries.notes: payo 取旧义乡人粗呢外套；汉字存疑（捀/捧）且音写不合，释义欠稳

entries.zh: 罩手帕；以手巾罩盖（帕〔疑或作巾〕）
entries.en: to cover/veil over with a handkerchief-cloth
entries.notes: 字存疑（帕/巾），音写合「罩手巾」，义为罩掩

entries.zh: 戴天；顶戴于天，以天为覆
entries.en: to carry heaven overhead (be covered/crowned by the sky)
entries.notes: 西语字面「覆盖天空」与「戴天」顶戴义有出入，取天覆于首之义

entries.zh: 拥抱；张臂掩抱（怀抱）
entries.en: to embrace; clasp in the arms

entries.zh: 掀起；揭盖开掩（字存疑：衒/衍）
entries.en: to cover and uncover; lift open
entries.notes: 字存疑（衒/衍），音写 hiēn/qûi 合「掀起」，取揭开之义

entries.zh: 掀落；揭除覆盖（字存疑：衒/衍）
entries.en: to uncover; lift off (the cover)
entries.notes: 字存疑（衒/衍），音写合「掀落」，取揭除之义

entries.zh: 天覆地载；天盖地而地承载万物（戴〔或作载〕）
entries.en: heaven covers the earth; earth carries/bears all things
entries.notes: 「戴/载」形近存疑，成句「天覆地载」，义不因字异

entries.zh: 覆坟掩墓；以石灰封坟（土墓）
entries.en: to cover the grave/tomb with lime

entries.zh: 甲被掩身；以被盖覆（甲被）
entries.en: to cover with the hand (likely recte 'with the blanket/manta', cf. kah-puè)
entries.notes: 西语作 con la mano，据汉字「甲被」(kah-puē) 当为 con la manta 之讹
